scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=lib/index.js --packages=external && node -e "const f=require('./index.js'); console.log('CommonJS exports:', Object.keys(f)); Promise.resolve(import('./index.js')).then(m=>{ console.log('ES module exports:', Object.keys(m)); if (!m.startRun?.__endpoint || !m.submitRun?.__endpoint || !m.cleanupExpiredRuns?.__endpoint) process.exit(1) }).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})" && node -e "require('firebase-functions/lib/runtime/loader').loadStack(process.cwd()).then(x=>{ console.log('Direct SDK manifest:',Object.keys(x.endpoints)); if (!x.endpoints.startRun || !x.endpoints.submitRun || !x.endpoints.cleanupExpiredRuns) process.exit(1) }).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase --debug emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-cebulak-express --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:emulator"
